Since MKT is over, I will take the TT bot offline this Tuesday. In its place, I have created a site where you can view the leaderboards and player history just like with the bot. This site has a toggle that will show old submissions, including videos if applicable, and when viewing a player’s profile, it will list all their current and historical world records. https://timetrials.mktour.workers.dev/

in addition, @SuperFX created https://mktwrs.com/ where you can find detailed info on world records! There you can see the exact date when someone took the record for each course as well as how many days someone held the record for.

It’s important to note the records between the two sites are not exactly the same. On the leaderboard site, a WR is only set at the end of a tour, but on mktwrs, a WR  is set whenever a record is beaten. In addition, the leaderboard site only uses data from the spreadsheet, but mktwrs obtained submissions from multiple sources.
